articles.title: U.S. DOJ seeks $61 million in what it calls Iran's crypto-laundered black market oil sales
articles.snippet: Prosecutors have filed a civil forfeiture complaint against what they call Iran's illegal crypto proceeds that are used to fund its military.

articles.title: Strategy Buys Back $139 Million of STRC, Bitcoin Stack Frozen for Second Week
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin treasury firm slowed its preferred-stock buyback from last week's $176 million pace and left its 845,050 BTC untouched, per a Monday SEC filing.

articles.title: Revolut Leaks Passports, Bitcoin Transaction Histories to Fake Government Request
articles.snippet: The fintech company fulfilled a fraudulent information request sent from a government agency's own email domain, exposing ID documents and full crypto transaction histories for a "limited" number of users.
